verdict.rationale: Abacum has a dedicated scenario-planning use case: you build base, bull and bear versions off the same base and watch revenue, hiring and cash move together when an assumption changes. Scenarios live alongside actuals and forecasts in one workspace, and headcount planning sits in the same connected model, which covers a hiring-wave scenario. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a side-by-side scenario comparison view, specific examples like a slipped-quarter timing shift, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
